_edit_me: THIS is the file to edit to change the demo. Then: npm run demo:build (regenerates scenarios/demo-dib-small.json) and npm run demo:reset. The drift-guard test in tests/integration/demo-profile.test.ts fails if the generated scenario and this config disagree.
description: GP-STACKSIM-1 M4 demo profile: Ridgeline Fabrication (FICTIONAL), a 13-seat DoD machine-shop subcontractor. Realistic staff, groups, and devices built through the real resolver path, with deliberate findable gaps: MFA stuck in report-only, an unencrypted non-compliant shared shop-floor kiosk, a shared login account, and the IT contractor's daily-driver admin account. Re-running this scenario IS the reset (deterministic wipe + rebuild).
